The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules.
